title: Utility Services Terms: Reliance on the Deposit by Lease Payment Standing at Move-Out
content:
# Lease Standing Share — Utility Services Program Move-Out Utility Payment

**Term.** In working out the move-out utility payment of a Utility Services Program account, the deposit expected to reach utilities is relied on in a lease standing share set by two tests on the Apartment Home Lease — it is enrolled in rent autopay, and it is not restricted to certified funds:

1. **1.0** when the lease is enrolled in rent autopay and is not restricted to certified funds;
2. **0.50** when exactly one of those two holds;
3. **0 (no reliance)** when neither holds.

The deposit expected to reach utilities is multiplied by the lease standing share in arriving at the deposit relied on; the product is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Every combination

| Enrolled in rent autopay | Restricted to certified funds | Lease standing share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no | 1.0 |
| yes | yes | 0.50 |
| no | no | 0.50 |
| no | yes | 0 |

*Cases (hypothetical deposit expected to reach utilities of $240.00):* taken at the lease standing share it is $240.00 for a lease on autopay and not restricted, $120.00 for a lease on autopay and restricted to certified funds, $120.00 for a lease neither on autopay nor restricted, and $0.00 for a lease not on autopay and restricted.
